en-US.description: The ADInstruments CODA Monitor Device Enabler is a software enabler for LabChart, allowing an ADInstruments CODA Monitor to stream data into LabChart.
en-US.longDescription:
The ADInstruments CODA Monitor Device Enabler is a software enabler for LabChart, allowing an ADInstruments CODA Monitor to stream data into LabChart.
A CODA Monitor utilizes Volume Pressure Recording (VPR) sensor technology to measure the tail blood pressure from awake or anesthetized mice or rats, and provide blood pressure parameters including:
- systolic blood pressure
- diastolic blood pressure
- mean blood pressure
- heart rate
- tail blood volume
- tail blood flow
en-US.name: ADInstruments CODA

zh-CN.description: ADInstruments CODA Monitor 设备启用器是一款专为 LabChart 设计的软件插件，可使 ADInstruments CODA Monitor 将数据实时传输至 LabChart 系统。
zh-CN.longDescription:
ADInstruments CODA Monitor 设备启用器是一款专为 LabChart 设计的软件插件，可使 ADInstruments CODA Monitor 将数据实时传输至 LabChart 系统。
该 CODA 监测仪采用容积压力记录（VPR）传感技术，能够测量清醒或麻醉状态下小鼠/大鼠的尾部血压，并提供以下血流动力学参数：
- 收缩压
- 舒张压
- 平均动脉压
- 心率
- 尾部血容量
- 尾部血流量
